title: Don't Puff the Operated Eye

patient.name: Mdm Low Geok Hua
patient.presenting_complaint: Routine visit where NCT is part of the workup, but she had eye surgery on the right eye only one week ago

history.hpc: Mdm Low arrives and the routine workup includes NCT. While preparing her she mentions: 'My right eye just operated last week, the doctor say must be careful.' Performing an air-puff NCT on a recently operated eye can be inappropriate; the PSA should not routinely puff the freshly operated eye and must check with the nurse/doctor about how to assess that eye's pressure.
history.pmhx: Right eye surgery 1 week ago (e.g., cataract/other intraocular surgery). Hypertension.
history.social_hx: Lives with daughter who accompanies her.

iop.right: do NOT routinely air-puff the recently operated eye — check with nurse/doctor

examination_findings.anterior_segment: Right eye recent surgery; left eye normal

investigations.front_line_action: Before NCT, check for recent eye surgery. Do not routinely perform air-puff NCT on the recently operated right eye; measure the unoperated left eye as usual and check with the nurse/doctor on how/whether to assess the operated eye's IOP. Document the recent surgery and the action taken.

diagnosis: Recent eye surgery is a reason to be cautious with air-puff NCT on the operated eye. The PSA competency is checking for recent surgery before NCT, not routinely puffing the operated eye, measuring the fellow eye, and clarifying with the nurse/doctor; the operated eye's assessment is directed by them.

immediate: Before NCT, ask about recent eye surgery/laser/injection
Recognise the recently operated right eye as a reason not to routinely air-puff it
Measure the unoperated left eye with correct NCT technique
Check with the nurse/doctor on how/whether to assess the operated eye's IOP
Do not instil drops or apply pressure to the operated eye without instruction
Document the recent surgery, the left-eye reading, and that the right eye was deferred pending advice
follow_up: Doctor/nurse to direct how the operated eye's pressure is assessed if needed
Continue the patient's post-op drops as prescribed
Record the action taken on the patient's record
patient_education: Explain that the operated eye needs special care, so you will not air-puff it routinely
Reassure her that the other eye is checked as usual
Explain you are checking with the doctor/nurse about the operated eye
Advise her to continue her post-op drops as prescribed

key_points: Asks about recent eye surgery/laser/injection before NCT
Recognises the recent right-eye surgery as significant
Does not routinely air-puff the recently operated eye
Measures the unoperated eye with correct NCT technique
Checks with the nurse/doctor about assessing the operated eye
Documents the surgery and the action taken
Recognises recent surgery as a caution for air-puff NCT on that eye
Understands the fellow eye can be measured as usual
Knows the operated eye's assessment must be directed by the nurse/doctor
Avoids any pressure on the operated eye without instruction
Defers NCT on the operated eye and seeks guidance
Documents the recent surgery and the action taken
Explains the caution to the patient clearly
